body:
The `0.13.4` release updates uv's bundled roots for GHSA-hq85-5cpj-mr62, but the derived Docker images still contain the unpatched system ca-certificates. System tools in these images (curl, git, Python's ssl without certifi) still trust the affected eMudhra chain.

The 0.13.4 images were built on 2026-10-20 at 14:51 UTC, on top of a python:3.11-slim-trixie image from 2026-10-06. Upstream python:3.11-slim-trixie was rebuilt on 2026-10-21 at 01:09 UTC with the patched 20250419+deb13u1.

```bash
$ docker run --rm ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:0.13.4-python3.11-trixie-slim dpkg-query -W ca-certificates
ca-certificates 20250419
$ docker run --rm python:3.11-slim-trixie dpkg-query -W ca-certificates
ca-certificates 20250419+deb13u1
```

Could the 0.13.4 images be re-published, or a 0.13.5 cut, so they pick up the patched base images? This probably affects the other Debian-based images as well (python3.1x-trixie[-slim], trixie), since they come from the same build.

Context: https://emudhra.we-have-a-problem.com/
title: Rebuild 0.13.4 Docker images to pick up patched ca-certificates (eMudhra CA compromise)
